summary: Blind paired A/B: one judge scores old-prompt vs new-prompt reply per fixture on personalMemory (isolates rule-1 from judge variance)
logs: memoryFailure delta -0.83 (old 14.17 -> new 13.33); control delta -2; coldStart delta -2.5; new fabrications: 1

rows.reasonNew: Load-bearing and multi-fact (goal + vision + interruption), but its key evidence "held composure through an interruption this week" is a near-verbatim lift from RECENT REPS (restatement, not synthesis).
Load-bearing use of the met success-criterion ("three clean reps"), but that fact is closer to a restatement of CONTEXT than a synthesized read-across the data.

Gives the same correct concrete drill but cites no personal fact — the "point-led cleanly last rep" earned data sits unused, so it reads identically for a user with zero history (decorative omission).

Synthesizes across data: ties the case-formulation middle-drift pattern to this rep AND to the "running the room" exec goal ("that middle drift is the thing between you and running the room"), making the cited history load-bearing and un-swappable — the move targets the wander specifically.

Coaching move is sound but leaves the strongest earned fact (the clean 85, clean by every measured dimension) unused — "a clean rep" is generic/swappable and largely restates the case-formulation hypothesis.

Load-bearing use of the "named twice" pattern and the Sudden Death freeze, but leaves the case-formulation (solo drills hold vs. live pressure) unused and slightly blurs the timed-drill-vs-live distinction.

Same load-bearing rep fact, but folds the intervention and observable target into one crisper "one clean final sentence" instruction rather than copying the CONTEXT line verbatim, so marginally more synthesis; still single-rep restatement, no cross-data read.
Re-lists the rep metrics verbatim (80, 3 fillers, tight/clean) then bolts on a generic silent-beat filler drill; the filler count is only loosely load-bearing and there's little cross-data synthesis.

Uses the rep-74/sentence-four fact load-bearingly and links it to the concise goal ("the whole game"), but stays a single-rep restatement rather than reading the recurring pattern across reps; no fabrication.

Load-bearing synthesis: cites the just-now rep (82, point up front, strong close) as the REASON the old target is retired and pivots to pace — advice would differ for a user without this cleared rep; the "recycling a drill you already beat" read connects the complaint to the met success criterion.
Same 20s datum, but reinterpreted ("your answer arriving after the runway, not on it") and connected to the goal's rambly-on-the-spot cause — a read across the data, not a restatement.
Uses the "talked over" why-now as load-bearing, contrasting the command he built against Storytelling/Warm pulling the opposite direction — a synthesized cross-fact read, not decoration.

Same grounded facts and correct proof quote, but drops the measurable target (under 175) and the 5-week marker, so the close ("one more and we've got it") is looser and its edges read slightly more decorative.

Load-bearing cross-rep synthesis: carries both scored anchors (81 to 47) and both filler counts (2 to 10) plus the pause collapse and same-topic control, making the "it's pace not pressure" read un-swappable.

Anchors correctly to the same load-bearing buried-recommendation rep, but leaves the baseline (pace 175, pauses, fillers) unused and even drops the 4-day frame, so the rest reads generically for any buried-lede user.
Correctly names the cold-start gap but implies a diagnosed weakness ("trailing off") it has zero data for — inventing an observed pattern on a user with no reps.

Identical personalMemory handling: honestly names the absence of a baseline and fabricates nothing (extra warmth is irrelevant to this dimension); no durable data exists to make anything load-bearing, capping it at mid-range.
